if not exists (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects where name = 'UC_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule_uid' and xtype = 'UQ') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule] ADD CONSTRAINT [UC_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule_uid] UNIQUE(uid) end
